children: Empire Petroleum entered into a financing agreement, issuing a $3.25 million 6% convertible promissory note to Petroleum Independent & Exploration to support working capital. The note matures on Mar 10, 2028 and is convertible at $2.838 per share from Nov 9, 2026 until maturity, representing up to 1,145,173 shares if fully converted. Interest steps up to 9% after maturity, and the company may prepay with notice. The company will seek NYSE American approval to list the underlying shares.
